title: AddAssets

AssetApproval.description: A named person's approval of an asset for use.

at.description:
When they approved, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Authoring metadata
only: nothing on the render path reads it (invariant 8).

user.description: The approving user, as the authorization layer names them (2.9).

AssetAvailability.description: Whether an asset's bytes are available where they are needed.

AssetKind.description:
The kind of thing an asset is. `Font` is here so the asset store and the
font subsystem agree on what a font asset is.

AssetLibraryItem.description:
An asset as the library knows it. Carries **both** addresses: the content
hash (immutable, addresses the store) and the project-relative path
(mutable, addresses the library). The hash is what a scene's bindings
resolve against, so re-importing over the same path — a new render of the
same logo — updates the hash but never the binding.

assetId.description: Stable scene-facing id. Survives relink; distinct from any storage id.

checksum.description: Content hash — the store address. `None` only while importing.

name.description: Display name, separate from the on-disk name (ADR-0002 B.3).

provenance.description:
Where the bytes came from and under what terms (11.39). Every record
carries one, and it is always written: a human-made asset may leave
every field empty, but the schema is present in every saved project.

AssetOrigin.description: Who or what produced an asset's content.

oneOf.description: A person made it, including a file a person brought into the project.

A deterministic tool derived it from other inputs: a conversion, an
export or a render.

AssetProvenance.description: Where an asset's bytes came from and under what terms.

c2paManifest.description: An attached C2PA manifest: a project-relative path or a URI.

promptHash.description:
SHA-256 of the prompt a model was given. The prompt text is not
stored with the asset.

provider.description:
Who supplied the bytes: a font service, a stock library, a model
vendor.

sources.description:
What the asset was made or fetched from: file names, URLs, the content
hashes of input assets. Always written, so the field is visible in a
saved project even when it is empty.

ContentHash.description: Content address of asset bytes: SHA-256, lowercase hex.

LicenseClass.description:
The terms an asset may be used under, as a class a show profile can test
(13.8) rather than free licence text.

oneOf.description: Made by or for the production, which holds the rights.

An open licence that permits commercial use: OFL, CC0, CC BY,
Apache-2.0, MIT.
GPL-class: obligations attach when it is redistributed.
Licensed for non-commercial use only, such as CC BY-NC.
Licensed for editorial or news use only.
Limited by territory, term or medium.

ProvenanceTool.description: The tool, or for model origin the model, that made or imported the bytes.

description:
Add imported assets with the provenance their import filled in
(11.39). The only way a non-font asset enters a scene.
